reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 6 points better, in a game of about 244 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Wizards.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (confidence, revenge).
Bottom line: the Bulls win 61 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 216 and 264 total points.

analyst.text: Both sides come in lifted. Washington ended an eight-game skid behind AJ Dybantsa's first double-double, and Chicago made a franchise-record 15 first-half threes in a 30-point rout in Brooklyn. Washington won the October meeting 124-120. The Bulls are without rookie Caleb Wilson (hand). No clear lean; neutral.
